NOR flash.why: Real flash memory architecture; NOR, SPI-NOR and NOR flash memory are the same kind.

EEPROM.why: Real non-volatile memory kind; well-known to working engineers, so Null pointer exception fits.

SDRAM.why: Real JEDEC DRAM kind; common knowledge among hardware-literate players.

PROM.why: Real one-time-programmable ROM kind; Null pointer exception is a reasonable tier.

DVD.why: Real optical storage format; DVD-ROM is a variant name of the same format.

SD card.why: Real flash storage card format; Secure Digital and SD memory card are plain names for it.

3D XPoint.why: Real memory technology (Intel/Micron); Optane is the product name for the same technology, so it is an alias.

High Bandwidth Memory.why: Real JEDEC stacked DRAM standard; HBM2 and HBM3 are generations named as aliases, not new entries.

RAM.why: Generic kind name for the memory class, the most common answer to the prompt; 'ram memory' is a plain alias.

MRAM.why: Real magnetoresistive memory technology; tier fits deep-cut knowledge.

DRAM.why: Real and very common memory kind; Off-by-one is the right tier.

solid-state drive.why: Real storage technology built on NAND flash; SSD is its standard abbreviation alias.

NVRAM.why: Real named class of non-volatile RAM technologies; non-volatile RAM is a plain alias.

FRAM.why: Real ferroelectric memory kind; FeRAM and ferroelectric RAM are plain aliases.

VRAM.why: Real graphics memory kind (dual-ported DRAM); video RAM and video memory are plain aliases.

CD-ROM.why: Real optical storage format; compact disc is a plain generic alias of the medium.

cache memory.why: Named memory kind in computer architecture; CPU cache and processor cache are plain aliases.

USB flash drive.why: Real flash storage device kind; thumb drive, USB stick and pen drive are plain names for it.

LPDDR.why: Real JEDEC mobile DRAM standard; LPDDR4 and LPDDR5 are generations used as aliases. Race condition is a fair tier for specialists.

CompactFlash.why: Real flash memory card format; CF card and CompactFlash card are plain names for it.
